verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me and heard my cry.
He lifted me out of a terrible pit, out of the mud and clay. He set my feet on a rock and gave me a firm place to stand.
He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see it and be amazed, and they will trust in the LORD.
Happy is the person who trusts in the LORD, who does not look to proud people or to those who turn to lies.
LORD my God, you have done many wonderful things, and you have many plans for us. No one can compare with you. If I tried to tell about them all, there would be too many to count.
You did not want sacrifices and offerings. You have opened my ears to listen. You did not ask for burnt offerings and sin offerings.
Then I said, "Here I am. I have come. It is written about me in the scroll of the book.
I am happy to do what you want, my God. Your law is in my heart."
I have told the good news of your goodness to the great crowd. LORD, you know I have not closed my lips.
I have not hidden your goodness in my heart. I have talked about your faithfulness and how you save. I have not kept your faithful love and truth secret from the great crowd.
LORD, do not hold back your tender mercy from me. May your faithful love and truth always protect me.
So many troubles surround me that I cannot count them. My sins have caught up with me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs on my head. I have lost all courage.
Please, LORD, rescue me. Hurry, LORD, and help me.
Let all those who are trying to kill me be put to shame and confused. Let those who want to hurt me be turned back in disgrace.
Let those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" be shocked by their own shame.
But let all who look for you be full of joy and gladness because of you. Let those who love your saving help always say, "The LORD is great!"
But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my helper and my rescuer. My God, do not wait.
